name: specialization_at_js_scenarios
description: Automated test scenarios for specialization project using WebdriverIO and Cucumber.
author: Eliana Méndez

scripts.test:smoke: npm run clean:reports && wdio run wdio.conf.ts --cucumberOpts.tagExpression='@smoke'
scripts.test:register: npm run clean:reports && wdio run wdio.conf.ts --spec ./src/test/features/user-registration.feature
scripts.test:login: npm run clean:reports && wdio run wdio.conf.ts --spec ./src/test/features/user-login.feature
scripts.test:validLogin: npm run clean:reports && wdio run wdio.conf.ts --spec ./src/test/features/user-login.feature --cucumberOpts.tagExpression='@validLogin'
scripts.test:invalidLogin: npm run clean:reports && wdio run wdio.conf.ts --spec ./src/test/features/user-login.feature --cucumberOpts.tagExpression='@invalidLogin'
scripts.test:profile: npm run clean:reports && wdio run wdio.conf.ts --spec ./src/test/features/user-profile.feature
scripts.test:homeProduct: npm run clean:reports && wdio run wdio.conf.ts --spec ./src/test/features/home-page.feature
scripts.test:basket: npm run clean:reports && wdio run wdio.conf.ts --spec ./src/test/features/basket.feature
scripts.test:checkout: npm run clean:reports && wdio run wdio.conf.ts --spec ./src/test/features/checkout.feature
scripts.test:smoke:report: npm run test:smoke && npm run report:serve
